patch.value: Validate only context assumptions invalidated on resume

Record section-to-source digests for context packets and return only invalidated assumptions on resume. Acceptance: changed dependencies invalidate dependent packet sections; unchanged packets reuse safely; deleted or unreadable sources fail with a bounded receipt. Provide typed SDK and CLI, compact TOON/JSON, typed refusals with remedies, documentation and non-git public-tracker validation.

value.text: Overlap recheck: SDK workspace snapshots retain complete files and revisions; core context usage/improvement ledgers record observations and delivery. pm-brief since and pm-context context-pack since report events; pm-memory verify checks memory claims. Implement a portable digest-only manifest, typed SDK and context-freshness record/resume commands, with bounded fail-closed receipts. Builds on PR #164; no snapshot store or second delta stream.
